build_task_template: build a PHYRE task template that funnels a ball onto a target floor pad using angled bars
create_dynamic_ball: create a dynamic ball object positioned at the top of the scene with configurable scale and x offset
add_static_bars: add static bar objects to form a funnel shape with configurable angle and placement on left or right side
update_task_relationships: update the task to require the ball touching the target using SpatialRelationship.TOUCHING
skip_invalid_params: skip template parameters when the funnel gap is too narrow for the ball to pass through
